backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing user profiles and per-user prompts/categories with authorization checks and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of concise descriptions summarizing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Guide for diagnosing deployment failures with steps, common issues, and quick fixes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the React app and favicon assets.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component handling authentication, prompt/category management UI, and backend sync.
frontend/src/components/auth/SignInScree: Sign‑in screen component prompting users to authenticate via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/categories/Categ: Renders a filter bar allowing users to toggle favorites and select categories via badges. Fetches categories from the store and handles selection state.
Provides UI to add new categories and select existing ones with checkboxes. Supports paste handling and prevents duplicate category creation.
frontend/src/components/categories/Manag: Dialog for renaming and deleting categories, showing usage counts and confirming deletions. Integrates with backend sync and paste cleaning.
frontend/src/components/importExport/Imp: UI controls for exporting prompts to JSON and importing them from a file. Saves imported data to backend and refreshes state.
frontend/src/components/prompts/ConfirmD: Generic confirmation dialog wrapper using AlertDialog. Presents title, description, and confirm/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptAc: Action buttons for prompts including copy, favorite, duplicate, edit, and delete. Converts HTML to text for copying and shows tooltips.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptCo: Displays sanitized HTML prompt content using dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Ensures cleaned content is shown safely.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEd: Dialog for creating or editing prompts with title, content editor, categories, and favorite toggle. Handles validation, sanitization, and save actions.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptGr: Displays prompts in a responsive card grid with previews, categories, and actions. Converts content to plain text for preview display.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptLi: Renders a list of prompt cards with categories, content preview, and action buttons. Shows an empty state when no prompts exist.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptPr: Displays a dialog previewing a prompt’s title and content. Opens when a prompt is provided and open is true.
frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptTa: Renders prompts in a sortable table with categories, modified date, and actions, and supports clicking rows to preview prompts. Integrates PromptPreviewDialog for detailed viewing.
frontend/src/components/search/SearchInp: Provides a search input with an icon and paste-cleaning handler. Updates the parent with the current search string.
frontend/src/components/sorting/SortDrop: Dropdown for selecting the prompt sorting mode. Emits changes to the parent on selection.
frontend/src/components/views/ViewModeTo: Toggle buttons to switch between list, grid, and table view modes. Highlights the active mode.
frontend/src/features/auth/iiProviderLog: Utilities to validate II provider URLs, build a safe logout URL, and perform full-page logout with session tracking. Handles blocked domains, return URL cleanup, and logout state recovery.
frontend/src/features/auth/logoutReturnU: Returns a fixed post-logout redirect URL containing the required caffeineAdminToken hash. Used for navigating back after II logout.
frontend/src/features/auth/useReliableII: React hook coordinating a reliable II logout by clearing local auth, waiting for anonymous identity, then navigating to provider logout. Exposes logout state and errors.
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibr: API wrapper mapping frontend prompt and category types to backend formats and performing CRUD operations. Handles ID generation, type translation, and backend calls.
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptL: Hook that syncs prompts and categories with the backend after authentication, merges local favorites, clears data on logout, and provides backend-persisted actions. Manages initial load and error handling.
frontend/src/features/categories/categor: Zustand store managing category list with add, rename, delete, set, and clear operations including duplicate checks.
frontend/src/features/clipboard/useCopyT: React hook providing clipboard copy functionality with modern API and fallback plus copied-state handling.
frontend/src/features/importExport/expor: Exports prompts and categories as a JSON file with versioning and timestamp.
frontend/src/features/importExport/impor: Imports prompts from a JSON file with schema validation and ID collision handling.
frontend/src/features/importExport/schem: Defines export data shape and validates imported prompt objects for required fields.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPastedT: Cleans pasted text, preferring plain text and extracting structured text from HTML when needed.
frontend/src/features/paste/cleanPasteHa: Provides paste handlers that clean pasted content before inserting into inputs or contentEditable fields.
Filters prompts by favorites, category, and case-insensitive search across fields.
frontend/src/features/prompts/id.ts: Generates simple unique IDs using timestamp and random string.
frontend/src/features/prompts/promptStor: Zustand store managing prompt CRUD, duplication, favorites, and category updates.
frontend/src/features/prompts/sorting.ts: Sorts prompts by various modes including date, title, favorites, and recent edits.
frontend/src/features/prompts/types.ts: Defines Prompt structure and enums for view and sort modes.
frontend/src/features/richText/htmlToPla: Converts HTML to plain text by stripping tags and normalizing whitespace.
frontend/src/features/richText/sanitizeH: Sanitizes HTML by allowing only safe formatting tags and removing unsafe or noisy elements.
frontend/src/features/richText/SimpleRic: ContentEditable-based rich text editor with bold, italic, color tools and cleaned paste handling.
frontend/src/features/storage/localStora: Loads and saves simple UI preferences like view mode to localStorage.
frontend/src/features/storage/useAutoPer: Hook that loads UI prefs on mount and saves viewMode to localStorage when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor based on identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and stored-identity restoration.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and extensive OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/lib/favicon.ts: Deprecated no-op function kept only for backwards compatibility.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app with React, QueryClient, and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling custom OKLCH color theme, animations, fonts, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a prompt app and pending work on global paste sanitization.
